_readme: One entry per place a LEADFUSE application link gets posted. slug = the folder under /apply/ and the value of formsource + utm_source. medium = utm_medium. utm_campaign is always 'apply'. Add a row, run build.py, commit. Never rename a slug that has already been posted somewhere.

root.where: leadfuse.co itself (nav, footer, anyone who types /apply)

sources.where: LEADFUSE Training Material (the free Skool room): lesson 4.3, Start Here, pinned post
Skool anywhere else: profile bio, posts in other communities
LEADFUSE VIP (the paid room): upgrades and renewals
YouTube descriptions, pinned comments, end screens
Emails from the App (nurture, follow-up, newsletters)
